lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lanterns, smoke, a hundred voices you don't have to answer.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The stadium looms a block away, dark and patient.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lanterns, smoke, and the dumpling stall that knows your face now.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You catch yourself checking the stadium lot anyway. Old habit. New thread.

beats.prompt: The market pulls in three directions.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For eight minutes the headset doesn't exist.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Past the last lanterns, the market thins into shadows — and there they are.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Vans by the stadium lot. Engines running at midnight. You memorize a plate without deciding to.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The vans again. Same corner, different plates.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That's not a coincidence anymore. That's a schedule.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A small thing from a crowded stall — the kind of gift that says 'I thought of you on a Tuesday.'

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Those are the ones people keep.
